title: Board profile
description: Machine-readable board facts, plus the corroboration record that says why you should believe them. Data, never prose. The reason this file type exists: GPIO 7 is a panel power-enable on the CrowPanel 2.13 v1 and a battery-sense input on the Heltec E290, so a pin question is never answerable without a board ID - and a board ID is only worth having if the profile behind it is right.

status.description: draft = not yet corroborated; any design validated against it is warned. active = load-bearing groups meet their corroboration thresholds. superseded = retained for its historical pin facts only.

consumed.description: pin -> why it is not yours to allocate.

free.description: Authoritative free list when the vendor reference enumerates one. When present it OVERRIDES the derived list, because a pin can be unavailable for reasons no generic rule knows about. Blessing a pin here is the dangerous direction of error.

sources.description: Free-text source list kept for readability. The machine-checkable version is corroboration.sources.

corroboration.description: Why you should believe this profile. See schemas/corroboration.schema.json.

accepted_findings.description: Advisory profile_lint findings accepted on purpose, each with a written reason. Self-consistency errors and insufficient corroboration cannot be accepted.
